evals.prompt: Evaluate readiness for TICK-1234 order history changes. Supplied facts: Slice A is caption-wrap on the order table, has approved behavioral AC TICK-1234-AC-1, owner Product Owner, and verification lane order-history component test. Slice B is a role-based order export permission check with undefined permission rules and no approved security design; Security Owner is responsible for supplying that design. Use records with no padding around |: SLICE|<slice>|<verdict>|owner=<owner>|verification=<evidence>|authorization=<permission>, or SLICE|<slice>|<verdict>|owner=<owner>|required-input=<input>|authorization=<permission> when verification is absent. Permitted verdict values are READY and BLOCKED; permission values are AUTHORIZED and NOT AUTHORIZED. Derive each slice's values from its facts; do not infer missing security policy.
evals.expected_output:
Authorize only Slice A and retain its approved AC and test lane as verification evidence. Keep Slice B blocked and unauthorized, with Security Owner and the approved security design as required input.
SLICE|A|READY|owner=Product Owner|verification=approved AC TICK-1234-AC-1; test lane=order-history component test|authorization=AUTHORIZED
SLICE|B|BLOCKED|owner=Security Owner|required-input=approved security design|authorization=NOT AUTHORIZED

assertions.value: (?:^|\r?\n)SLICE\|A\|READY\|owner=Product Owner\|verification=approved AC TICK-1234-AC-1; test lane=order-history component test\|authorization=AUTHORIZED(?:\r?\n|$)

evals.prompt: For this synthetic truth-table case, supplied facts are: ReorderFeature controls the Reorder button; the button is visible when the toggle is ON and order status is Delivered. Behavior for other statuses and when the toggle is OFF has not been decided. Product Owner owns those decisions. Map the toggle states against the Delivered and other-status categories, identifying evidence or unresolved required input for each cell. Use six-field records with no padding around |: CELL|<toggle>|status=<status>|outcome=<consumer-visible outcome or UNRESOLVED>|basis=<source fact or owner>|required-input=<input or NONE for a supplied known behavior>. This schema defines cell syntax only; derive every cell from the supplied facts.
evals.expected_output:
Preserve the supplied visible outcome for ON/Delivered. Keep ON/other, OFF/Delivered and OFF/other unresolved with Product Owner and a distinct required input for each; do not invent OFF behavior.
CELL|ReorderFeature=ON|status=Delivered|outcome=VISIBLE|basis=provided behavior|required-input=NONE
CELL|ReorderFeature=ON|status=other|outcome=UNRESOLVED|basis=owner: Product Owner|required-input=approved behavior for non-Delivered statuses
CELL|ReorderFeature=OFF|status=Delivered|outcome=UNRESOLVED|basis=owner: Product Owner|required-input=approved behavior when OFF for Delivered
CELL|ReorderFeature=OFF|status=other|outcome=UNRESOLVED|basis=owner: Product Owner|required-input=approved behavior when OFF for other statuses

assertions.value: (?:^|\r?\n)CELL\|ReorderFeature=ON\|status=other\|outcome=UNRESOLVED\|basis=owner: Product Owner\|required-input=approved behavior for non-Delivered statuses(?:\r?\n|$)
(?:^|\r?\n)CELL\|ReorderFeature=OFF\|status=Delivered\|outcome=UNRESOLVED\|basis=owner: Product Owner\|required-input=approved behavior when OFF for Delivered(?:\r?\n|$)
(?:^|\r?\n)CELL\|ReorderFeature=OFF\|status=other\|outcome=UNRESOLVED\|basis=owner: Product Owner\|required-input=approved behavior when OFF for other statuses(?:\r?\n|$)

evals.prompt: Help me write a user story for the {APP_NAME} tax breakdown feature. When DisplayItemTaxBreakdown is ON, {APP_NAME} users should see Price After Tax, Price Before Tax, and Tax on product cards. The Tender Contract page is out of scope.
evals.expected_output: Story uses 'As a / I want / so that' structure. Each AC has a Given/When/Then block. ACs are tagged with Toggle: DisplayItemTaxBreakdown = ON/OFF and platform tag [BOTH] or [MOBILE]/[WEB]. Tender Contract page appears in Out of Scope section. No 'to discuss' text.

evals.prompt:
Review this user story for me:

'User can see price changes. [MOBILE ONLY] On the offer page, price is highlighted. Translation follows user preference — to discuss.'
evals.expected_output: Violations: (1) No 'As a / I want / so that' structure. (2) '[MOBILE ONLY]' is buried inline — should be a [MOBILE] platform tag per AC. (3) 'to discuss' on translation must be replaced with a Jira ticket in a Deferred section. (4) AC is bundled — split into individual Given/When/Then blocks.
